evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Rigour dominates — "structure, quality, and management of large volumes of data", "stored procedures and triggers", "complex SQL queries" — no agile or fast-iteration language.
evidence.domain_risk: Scoot is a budget airline (Singapore Airlines Group) — "large volumes of data from different sources within the business" to "facilitate decision-making and forward planning" in an aviation context implies material financial or operational consequences for data errors.
evidence.jd_authorship: Generalist recruiter with limited technical depth — generic phrases: "Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics / Computer Science / Information Technology / Mathematics / Statistics", "Ability to handle multiple tasks and support special project needs simultaneously"; tool names are accurate but framing is functional, not architecturally informed.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Predominantly fix/scale and maintain — "maintain and manage advanced reporting", "manage large volumes of data"; "Execute dashboard implementation" is the one build signal.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Role covers a wide remit — dashboards, reporting, SQL querying, data management, and business liaison — all in one "Senior Analyst" title, suggesting a lean team. The 2-year minimum experience bar for a "Senior" title signals a small organisation with thin seniority layers.
evidence.collaboration_width: Named explicitly: "end-users" (dashboard consumers), "technical and non-technical groups" (liaison role) — width is narrow (1–2 functional groups named).
evidence.urgency: No urgency signals present. Relatively low experience bar ("at least 2 years") for a Senior title may suggest a backfill or newly scoped role.
